1,4.2 Tai luster Features
Page 1-14
Peragraph five says that a velocity of 7.0 feet per second is in the discharge channel after passing through the trash rack structure. This is incorrect and should read that 6.8 feet per second velocity occurs in the discharge structure openings, not after passing through the trash rack structure. See Exhibit W. Section 1.4.3, Amendment 1.
Section 1.4.2 has been revised.
Page 1-16
Paragraph one states that a 5.8 feet per second velocity occurs in the Intake channel before the water enters the trashrack structure. During pumping, a 5.6 feet ar second velocity is in the structure openings, not in the channel before entering the trashracks. See Exhibit W, Section 1.4.3, Amendment 1.
Section 1.4.2 has been revised.
1.4.3 Access Roads and Tunnels
Page 1-16
The access tunnel to the surge chamber galley may not be required. Based on preliminary hydraulic transient analysis, the surge chamber can be eliminated.
Section 1.4.3 has been revised.
1.4.4 Transmission Facilities
Page 1-17
Paragraph three gives the transmission tower dimensions as 120 feet high and 40 feet square at the tower base. This has been revised by Améndment 1 (Exhibit W, Section 1.4.4) to a height varying from 96 feet to 176 feet and a base from 28 feet to 68 feet square at the ground line.
Section 1.4.4 has been revised.
1.6 Operational and Maintenance Procedures
Page 1-25
The last sentence in paragraph two states that in the event of flooding, egress could be negotiated by two access tunnels and the vertical bus shaft. This should be changed to one access tunnel and the vertical bus shaft.
Section 1.6 has been revised.
